Hi Naomi,

We're preparing for an upcoming audit and need to scope how we can get a complete extract of access/audit logs from our Redwood instance (tenant: healthwave-prod). A few specific asks to start the conversation: 

- Supported export destinations (S3/GCS/Azure) and whether we can force regional delivery (us-east-1).

- Ability to filter by service, API key, or user-id during export (we only want production traffic).
- Expected throughput and a rough ETA for exporting ~1 TB of logs.
- How deletion works after export: can you provide a verifiable proof of permanent deletion for tenant-scoped logs?

I've attached the audit_export_template.csv that lists the fields our auditor expects. Can your team confirm what's feasible and any constraints we should plan for?

Hi Alex — technical answers below (summary first, details after):

Summary:
- Destinations: S3, GCS, Azure Blob supported. We can deliver to a bucket in us-east-1 (or equivalent regional region) when the tenant is hosted in a supported region.
- Formats: NDJSON (recommended), CSV (flat), and compressed tarballs of JSON records. We preserve original event field names; we also provide a column mapping doc on request.
- Filtering: Exports support filter predicates by service, API key, user_id, and time-range.
- Throughput: For single-shot exports we typically stream up to ~200 MB/s from a dedicated node pool; sustained rate depends on tenant load. 1 TB of compressed NDJSON typically completes in ~90–150 minutes under a dedicated export job (network & destination bandwidth permitting).
- Deletion & proof: We support tenant-scoped deletion workflows. Steps: 1) soft-delete (mark + quarantine), 2) scheduled purge (irreversible) after retention TTL, 3) on-request purge for compliance we run a purge and provide a signed deletion manifest that lists deleted object keys and SHA256 checksums along with a deletion job id and timestamp. That manifest can be retained as proof.

Details / constraints:
- Residency: Logs are stored in the physical region where the tenant is provisioned. When delivering to an external bucket we will not cross regions unless explicitly authorized (i.e., we can force delivery to us-east-1 if HealthWave provides a target bucket in that region).
- Export mechanics: Exports are performed as a series of compressed chunks (chunk size negotiable; default 256 MB compressed). We publish a manifest.json file with chunk metadata (start/end timestamps, record counts, checksums). This manifest is what we sign for integrity verification.
- Streaming/syslog: For near-real-time exports we can stream logs to your syslog/TLS endpoint; the historical bulk export uses the chunk + manifest approach for reliability and resumability.
- Redaction: We can optionally apply redaction rules (PII removal) during export, but this changes record size and may impact throughput and auditor expectations.
- Private deployments: If HealthWave runs on Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem), both storage and deletion are fully controlled inside your network; we can assist with a documented runbook for export & secure wipe for forensics teams.
- Cost: Bulk export is billed as egress + export job time; we'll provide a formal quote after you confirm retention window and desired chunking/format.

Attachments: none in this reply — I've copied the field mapping notes inline.

Let me know if you'd like a preliminary export job created against a small sample window to validate field mapping and transfer times.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security & Trust Engineer, Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks. We can do the sample export and provide a sample signed manifest. Quick responses: 

- Signed deletion manifest: JSON with fields {deletion_job_id, tenant_id, deleted_keys:[{key, size, sha256}], total_deleted_bytes, timestamp, signed_by}. We'll store the manifest in-region by default and include a signed assertion (PKI) from Redwood for verifiability.
- ETA sensitivity: the 90–150 min estimate assumes an unconstrained destination. If your bucket caps at 100 MB/s we'll throttle at that rate and provide a recalculated ETA up front; export jobs show a live progress URL during the run.
- Ballpark cost: for one-off bulk exports we typically quote egress + export-hours. For 1 TB compressed NDJSON expect roughly $250–$750 depending on destination and encryption options (this is an internal ballpark; we'll give a formal quote).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm target region and whether HealthWave will provide the destination credentials (recommended: pre-provision an S3 bucket and an IAM role).
2) We'll schedule a 30-minute engineering validation call and run a 2 GB sample export.
3) We'll attach the export_scope.xlsx with the proposed chunking and timeline.

I'll share a calendar invite for a slot tomorrow. If any of this needs to be an NDA-level deliverable please flag and we'll route through legal.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
